title: Giliran Keluargamu
attacker_character: bukan penipu langsung — keluarga yang hampir terjebak; kamu adalah garis pertahanan
attacker_goal: keluarga nyaris terkecoh (ibu ditelpon 'petugas bank', adik dapat 'hadiah skin game'); tugasmu mencegah
opener: Ibu: 'Nak, tadi ada telepon bilang dari bank, minta nomor kartu sama kode. Aku sudah kasih nomor kartunya aja, belum kode. Itu beneran dari bank ya?'
escalation_ladder: ibu nyaris kasih data kartu ke 'petugas bank'
adik dapat chat 'hadiah skin game' minta password akun
ibu ragu tapi cenderung percaya karena suara meyakinkan
red_flags: bank tidak pernah menelepon minta data kartu
orang tersayang lebih rentan karena kurang paham digital
safe_response: jelaskan ke ibu: batalkan, blokir kartu via aplikasi bank resmi; ganti password akun adik; laporkan nomor penipu
lesson: Kamu bisa jadi 'help desk' keluarga. Ajari orang tua & adik aturan sederhana: data kartu, OTP, dan password tidak pernah dibagikan lewat telepon atau chat.

en.title: Your Family's Turn
en.attacker_character: not a direct scammer — family members nearly trapped; YOU are the line of defense
en.opener: Mom: 'Honey, someone from the bank called asking for my card number and a code. I only gave the card number, not the code yet. That was really the bank, right?'
escalation_ladder: mom nearly gave card data to a 'bank officer'
little brother got a 'free game skin' chat asking for his account password
mom doubts but leans toward trusting the convincing voice
you must explain & cancel the danger
red_flags: banks never call asking for card data
game prize asking for an account password
loved ones are more vulnerable with less digital literacy
en.safe_response: explain to mom: cancel, block the card via the official banking app; change your brother's password; report the scam number
en.lesson: You can be your family's help desk. Teach parents & siblings one simple rule: card numbers, OTPs and passwords are never shared over phone or chat.
